1. Numeric HALT thresholds must be committed before spend — never "reassess if it looks bad."
2. Include a same-input churn arm with a numeric floor whenever a design scores per-item presence/absence across LLM redraws; treat "effect inside churn floor" as a first-class outcome, not a failure.
3. Treat n=1 drift runs as anti-conservative and n=2 as producing a FLOOR, not an estimate — state this explicitly.
4. Outcome tables must be TOTAL and rows must PARTITION the outcome space — check total, two-sided, n-consistent, non-degenerate at this n.
5. Write NULL-composite rows explicitly for every arm that can read NULL, rather than deciding an unenumerated null after the data.
6. Apply two-sided calibration to every gate: plant a violation to confirm it fires, and run the clean case to confirm it stays quiet.
7. Pre-register selection rules for controls, including the RNG seed, before the arm they select on runs.
8. Include an explicit skip-as-moot branch in control selection rules.
9. For kill conditions, classify the CAUSE when a failure can have more than one cause with different correct responses — write this classification step into the prereg.
10. Pin an effect-size floor (magnitude, share above uniform expectation) before any grid value is computed, rather than relying on α.
11. Report the small stratum's MDE beside the effect-size floor.
12. If the MDE does not clear the effect-size floor, treat the condition as NOT a falsifier and stop.
13. Report a failed locked metric as failed, full stop — do not retro-fit a metric that passes.
14. After a failed locked metric, ask a NEW pre-registered question keyed on a quantity unobserved at lock time.
15. Recon gates must fire INTERACTIVELY — surface each to the operator at fire time with its witness and pre-committed branch, not post-hoc in the writeup.
16. Make freeze ordering witnessable: write PREREGISTRATION.md → md5sum it into audit_log.md ABOVE the first result → run.
17. On amendment, show both md5s with their positions in the audit log.
18. Split tolerance by indicator KIND (consumer safety vs process quality) and whether firing is systemic or idiosyncratic, rather than using an aggregate tolerance.
19. Ensure a churn/discount rule covers every payload-carrying file, not just one file standing in for all.

COUNT=19
